svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four 302.5 mm lengths of 20 x 2 flat bar; round the top corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On the centre line, from the bottom end: 6.5 mm at 12.5 (rail bolt);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill all four clamped together so the hopper holes match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flat on the outside face of a rail, bottom end flush with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail bottom, at 276 mm (front pair) and 425 mm (rear pair) from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rail front. The front bolt also passes the corner clip inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The hopper's side bosses sit flat on the uprights' inside faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each upright stands square to the rail (use a square).
